topic: DNS Cutover Execution Status — Fail-Closed Before DNS

execution_status.rationale: Authoritative nameservers are hosted on external registrar infrastructure (Hostinger). In accordance with Phase 17C.M7H-F16.1R mandate 'FAIL-CLOSED BEFORE DNS' and 'Do not mutate DNS', automatic DNS mutation is withheld. Live DNS remains pointing to Lovable Cloud / Cloudflare (185.158.133.1) until operator updates the DNS records in the DNS registrar management panel.
